subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor this cron timeline feature as a fresh/rebased Control UI implementation, or leave the linked issue open until a cleaner branch appears?
rationale: The feature is user-visible and useful, but accepting it now requires product ownership plus a substantial rebase and correctness work that automation should not infer from a stale conflicting branch.

options.title: Request a fresh/rebased PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against `ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts` that preserves current cron contracts.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the feature and own the larger rebase, status-contract, scheduler-accuracy, and i18n cleanup work.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open as a product backlog item without treating this stale branch as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh/rebased PR
recommendation.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against `ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts` that preserves current cron contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily Control UI product/surface ownership, and Val Alexander has recent adjacent Control UI history.
